desc:
JOIN OUR SERVER FOR CODES!

Build a global airline from nothing and out-fly every rival in the server.

Start with one airport, one used jet and a million dollars. Buy airports anywhere on a live 3D globe, draw routes with your mouse, set your ticket prices, and watch your planes cross the world in 60X Simulated Time. Every flight is a decision. Fuel prices change by the minute, cheap fares fill seats but eat your profit, and old jets need maintenance or regulators will ground them. Skip it and you'll make the front page for all the wrong reasons.

1,100+ real airports and real aircraft, from worn-out classics to brand-new jets.

Multi-stop routes, live day and night, and planes flying above real cities.
Hire pilots, manage staff morale, set company policy and invest in research.

Survive strikes, fuel spikes, crashes and bankruptcy
Compete for the global top 100 by net worth, fleet, routes and airports.

Every airline globally in the server is visible. Every move makes the news.
